### Props

| Name             | Type      | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------- | --------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `events`         | `array`   |          | `[]`    | The events, each `{ id, label, group, groupLabel, immediate, appDefault }`. From the host's catalogue.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `channels`       | `array`   |          | `[]`    | The channels, each `{ id, label, configured, unconfiguredReason }`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `groupValues`    | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | The group's values, as `{ [eventId]: { [channelId]: boolean } }`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `personalValues` | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | This person's values, same shape.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `forcedValues`   | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | What an administrator has forced, as `{ [eventId]: { [channelId]: { value, by, reason } } }`. A level ABOVE the person's own rather than another default: it is the administrator removing the choice, not setting it.                                                                                                                                             |
| `refusals`       | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | What the platform refuses for this recipient, same shape, each `{ reason }`. A refusal is not an absence: it is a rule, and the screen says which.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `adminMode`      | `boolean` |          | `false` | Whether this is the admin screen writing the group's defaults. The screen says a person's own value wins, so an administrator is not surprised when somebody does not get what they set.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `scopedValues`   | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | This person's narrower values, as `{ [eventId]: { [channelId]: { [scope]: boolean } } }`. Separate from `personalValues` rather than replacing it, so the global row keeps the flat shape every existing caller passes. A row left unset here falls through to the global value, which is what makes an absent scoped row an unanswered question rather than a no. |
| `scopeChoices`   | `array`   |          | `[]`    | The scopes a row can be narrowed to, each `{ id, label }`. Case domains or record types, named by whoever configured the app.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `digest`         | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | The digest per channel, as `{ [channelId]: { mode, timeOfDay } }` where mode is `off`, `daily` or `weekly`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `testResults`    | `object`  |          | `\{\}`  | The last test send per channel, as `{ [channelId]: { ok, message } }`. A refusal belongs here as much as a success: both are results.                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

### Events

| Name            | Payload | Description                                                                                                          |
| --------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change`        | —       | A cell was set.                                                                                                      |
| `add-scope`     | —       | A row was narrowed.                                                                                                  |
| `digest-change` | —       | Emitted when a reader changes a channel's digest mode or its time of day. Payload: `{ channelId, mode, timeOfDay }`. |
| `test-send`     | —       | Emitted when a reader asks for a test notification on one channel. Payload: `{ channelId }`.                         |
